title: Arkret AvailabilityReceipt
description: Content-addressed signed holder commitment that exact Event bytes remain available until retention_expires_at. Its content address is the Realm-suite digest of this complete object, including signature.

bytes_digest.description: Realm-suite digest of UTF8('ak.availability_event_bytes.v1') || 0x00 || JCS(the complete accepted EventEnvelope with only unsigned removed). event_id, actor_kind and all accepted producer/station proofs remain in the preimage.

holder_signer_evidence_ref.description: Content-addressed holder signer evidence. Its embedded digest is the sole wire copy (encoding.md 4.0.1).

$comment: The signature-free core is {realm_id,event_id,bytes_digest,holder_service_id,retention_expires_at,holder_signer_evidence_ref}. signature.payload_digest is the Realm-suite digest of RFC 8785 JCS(core). The full receipt content address is computed from this complete signed object and is carried only by selectors, Seal commitments and storage keys.
